# TextLabel

- Inherits [`UIObject`](uiobject.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("TextLabel")`

A UI object that shows text. Set `RichText` to use markup inside the text.

Text is laid out left to right, one character after another, with no kerning and no complex-script shaping. Scripts that need shaping, such as Arabic, Devanagari and Thai, are not displayed correctly.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Font` | `Content` | `""` | read/write | The font, as an `asset://` path to a TrueType file. An empty value, or the name `Inter`, uses the engine's default font, Inter.<br><br>A font that cannot be found falls back to the default, and a message is logged once. If the project has no font file at all, a built-in font is used that has only ASCII characters and one weight. |
| `RichText` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `Text` is read as markup, so that color, size and weight can change within one label.<br><br>The tags are `<b>` bold, `<i>` italic, `<u>` underline, `<s>` strikethrough, `<font color="#rrggbb" size="20" transparency="0.5">` with any of its three attributes, and `<br/>` for a line break. `color` also accepts `rgb(r, g, b)`. Tags can be nested, and each must be closed. Write `&lt;`, `&gt;`, `&amp;`, `&quot;` and `&apos;` for the literal characters.<br><br>A tag that is not recognized is shown as text. Bold and italic are synthesized from the label's one font file. A `TextInput` always shows its text without markup. |
| `Text` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The text to show, in UTF-8. A character the font does not have is drawn as the font's missing-glyph box. |
| `TextColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | The color of the text. |
| `TextOverflow` | `Enum.TextOverflow` | `Enum.TextOverflow.Overflow` | read/write | What happens to text that does not fit in the object, such as a long player name in a table row.<br><br>- `Overflow` draws the text beyond the object's edges. - `Clip` cuts the text at the object's edges. - `Ellipsis` shortens the text and ends it with an ellipsis. The text is measured in the label's font at the size it is drawn, so as much as fits is kept. On a single line, each line wider than the object is shortened. With `TextWrapped`, the lines that fit in the object's height are kept and the last one is shortened.<br><br>`Text` itself is never changed. Nothing is cut when `TextScaled` is on, or on an axis that `AutomaticSize` covers. With `RichText`, `Ellipsis` behaves like `Clip`. A `TextInput` scrolls its text and ignores this property. |
| `TextScaled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the text is drawn at the largest size that fits the object, ignoring `TextSize`. |
| `TextSize` | `number` | `14` | read/write | The size of the text, in pixels. Glyphs are drawn at the nearest whole size; the layout uses the exact value. |
| `TextTransparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the text is, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible). It is separate from `BackgroundTransparency`, so a label can fade its text and keep its background, or the reverse. A value outside 0 to 1 is kept as set and drawn as the nearer limit. |
| `TextWrapped` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether lines break at the object's width. Lines break at spaces. A word is broken only if it is wider than the object. |
| `TextXAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center` | read/write | The horizontal position of the text in the object: `Left`, `Center` or `Right`. |
| `TextYAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center` | read/write | The vertical position of the text in the object: `Top`, `Center` or `Bottom`. |
